facts.text: The party owes Warwick metal brought back from the Dwarven mine to the north. While they are gone he keeps Sir Phidipaldi's lyre to use against his night visitors.
The party must return Warwick's mithril chain shirt, his grandfather's armor. He holds the party's plate armor as collateral for it.
Wayman Tisdale wears Warwick's mithril shirt over his leather armor, on loan. It greatly improves his protection and halves damage from magic weapons and spells.
A natural-looking cave-in seals the Dwarven mine entrance, blocking the metal owed to Warwick. It can be dug through, and Dunk has partly broken through, uncovering a dead dwarf.

Warwick believes the Dwarven mine has metal and was worked by seven dwarves, but its cabin is burnt and its entrance caved in. Is there still metal to be had there, and are any of the dwarves left to deal with?
